data.description:
## Context / Problem

The point of a second engine is to compare it with the first. The epic requires a harness that runs both engines on the same ticket and ref and reports verdict agreement and finding overlap, run once over rebar's own eval corpus (`evals/`).

## Approach

Add an operator-run harness, `src/rebar/llm/evals/engine_comparison.py`, modelled on the existing operator harness `provider_parity.py` (same CLI shape, `--dry-run`, `--limit`, `--out`, never a CI job). For each corpus item it calls `review_plan(..., engine="pipeline", sign=False)` and `review_plan(..., engine="agentic", sign=False)` at the same ref, and reports: verdict agreement (exact PASS/BLOCK/INDETERMINATE match rate and the confusion matrix), blocking-decision flips, and finding overlap (findings matched by criterion and normalized text through `sidecar.norm_id`/`fix_unit_key`, `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sidecar.py:303,321`; reported as matched, pipeline-only and agentic-only counts). Corpus: the gold-labelled plan-review cases the parity harness already selects (`provider_parity.eligible_cases`/`select_corpus`), so both harnesses read one corpus definition. Results are written as JSON beside `provider_parity_results.json` and summarized in a ticket comment on the epic, with no cost figures. Reusing the parity harness's corpus selection and shape keeps the evidence comparable and avoids a second corpus definition.

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/evals/engine_comparison.py (new)
- src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/engine_comparison_results.json (recorded run)
- tests/unit/test_engine_comparison.py (new)
- docs/llm-framework.md (how to run it)

## Testing

- With `FakeRunner` scripted per engine: identical verdicts give agreement 1.0; one flipped item gives the expected confusion matrix; overlap counts match a hand-computed worked example (2 shared, 1 pipeline-only, 1 agentic-only).
- `--dry-run` lists the corpus and makes no model call.
- An item that errors on one engine is counted as an error, not as a disagreement.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `tests/unit/test_engine_comparison.py` passes, pinning agreement, confusion matrix, overlap and error handling.
- [ ] One run over the eval corpus is recorded in `engine_comparison_results.json` and summarized in a comment on the epic.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Engine comparison harness: verdict agreement and finding overlap over the eval corpus
